speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your newborn check-up. I will need to ask you a few questions to understand your baby's history and current condition. Do you have any concerns about their health, feeding, or behavior?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning. Based on your baby being a term female with no prenatal care and no immunization records, I need to know: has she shown any signs of jaundice, poor feeding, or unusual crying since birth?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Continuous heart murmur. I also have Bluish macules on the skin that do not blanch with pressure, Cloudy lenses in both eyes noticed upon examination, Failure to pass auditory screening tests.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome.

The combination of a continuous heart murmur (patent ductus arteriosus), bluish macules (blueberry muffin rash), cloudy lenses (cataracts), and hearing loss is pathognomonic for this congenital infection. Given the history of no prenatal care, this is highly consistent.
